_what: De-named public summary of the LCC ASC commercial-side savings engine. Cohort counts + savings bands only, no provider names. The full register and named worklists are internal (admin + Cabinet Member tiers).

fee_exception.note: Placements commissioned above the published rate card. Spend-under-review is scope, not a saving; the cashable figure is the realisation-discounted excess.

chc_exposure_to_defend.note: Lancashire is the 3rd-highest of 42 ICBs on NHS Continuing Healthcare. This is the cost the council would absorb if the NHS tightened eligibility, a funding-defence position, not a saving.

out_of_area.note: The 42.5% / ~£245m out-of-area headline is a CQC-match-failure artefact. The genuine out-of-county accommodation cohort is materially smaller; repatriation is a multi-year, gated programme.
